profile.name: HyunHo Kim
summary: I believe small differences in user experience shape a product's overall quality.
I turn design intent into code and improve maintainability through reusable components and clear file structures.
I validate critical user flows with Playwright-based end-to-end and unit tests, then start with reproducible conditions when resolving issues.
I automate repetitive work with AI, but always verify the results myself. I believe developers are ultimately responsible for delivering trustworthy outcomes.

experience.title: LogosAI
experience.role: AI Development Team · Full-Stack Web Developer

highlights.title: B2B AI Knowledge & Workflow Platform
items: Built the frontend and UI/UX for a Next.js-based AI agent platform from scratch.
Implemented chat streaming, agent settings, conversation history, file uploads, MCP execution results, and administrative views as one product flow.
Owned server implementation, tool definitions, and platform UI integration for chart, meeting-minutes, and project-status MCPs.

highlights.title: Meeting Minutes AI Pipeline
items: Built meeting-minute generation from browser-based live recording and audio-file uploads.
Split long audio into 20-minute chunks with 3-minute overlap and processed them in parallel to reduce LLM request limits and timeouts.
Combined transcription, diarization, and summaries into Markdown and DOCX meeting minutes.

highlights.title: AICC Voice Gateway
items: Built a Twilio SIP Trunk-based voice gateway.
Abstracted provider-specific STT/TTS settings and audio processing so providers can be selected from platform configuration.
Implemented VAD-based silence and background-noise handling, DTMF input, call sessions, and reconnection flows.

highlights.title: B2B AICC Platform External SI
items: Implemented the frontend for live STT transcription, post-call AI summaries, and call-history lookup for contact-center agents.
Added search, favorites, and a dedicated favorites tab after feedback that finding agents was difficult in large contact centers.

highlights.title: Deployment Environment
items: Built a container deployment path for dev and POC environments with GitHub Actions, Amazon ECR, and AWS SSM.
Reduced publicly exposed SSH access by moving to remote-command-based deployment and result checks.
